ai.title: Beyond the AI hype: How Industrial AI is reshaping India’s factories and infrastructure
ai.description: As India moves forward, artificial intelligence technologies are being woven into the fabric of its manufacturing, infrastructure, and transportation sectors. ai.title: Researchers develop DentalGEN, an AI framework for automated dental crown restoration
ai.description: A collaborative international research team led by the Faculty of Dentistry of the University of Hong Kong (HKU) has developed DentalGEN, a large-scale controllable generative artificial intelligence-plus (AI+) framework for automated dental crown restoration. Their study, published in npj Digital Medicine, represents an important advancement in digital prosthodontics, smart dental manufacturing and Industry 4.0 applications in dentistry.
